correction_reason: V1 trained on candidate dates through 2025-06-30 even when their fifth-session endpoint matured after the locked validation start 2025-07-01. A model notionally available at the validation start cannot use those not-yet-mature labels.
changes_from_v1: Training rows must have exit_date strictly before 2025-07-01 in addition to candidate date being within 2025H1.
V1 is retained as invalid causal-validation evidence and must not be used to tune features, model parameters, ranks, cooldown, TopN set, costs, or gates.

target_unchanged.entry: next official XTKS session open after candidate date
target_unchanged.exit: fifth official XTKS session close, with entry session counted as day 1

preprocessing_unchanged.feature_transforms: exactly as frozen; no data-driven clipping

core.model: LogisticRegression L2, C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, class_weight=balanced

monster.model: LogisticRegression L2, C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, class_weight=balanced

selection_unchanged.cooldown: 5 official XTKS sessions per symbol independently for each head/TopN; earlier same-day selection blocks later same-day selection

policy_choice_unchanged.core: among passing TopN policies choose highest top3-removed net mean; ties higher net median, lower loss10, smaller N
policy_choice_unchanged.monster: among passing TopN policies choose highest gross >=20% rate; ties higher top1-removed net mean, lower loss10, smaller N
policy_choice_unchanged.if_none_pass: NO_PROMOTION; no tuning against validation or 2026
